snippet.title: Surviving Mars Relaunched  | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The wait is over Surviving Mars: Relaunched has officially landed on Steam, Epic Games Store, Microsoft PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!

Surviving Mars: Relaunched includes all previous expansions, upgraded visuals and refined UI. Experience the brand-new political system the Martian Assembly that adds a new strategy layer, giving you choices that affect your colony's future, and even the possibility of independence from Earth. Whether you are returning or landing for the first time, your chance to bring life to the Red Planet is now here!

🛒Buy Now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3215050/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/surviving-mars-relaunched-928392
Microsoft PC: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9N707SLP2031
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-se/concept/10013017
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9NS8192KZVT3
